description: JACKAL verified computation kernel: formal-bounded range/Gaussian enclosures, independent receipt verification, and honest weaker-lane calculation (exact/checked/estimated/bounded) with status passthrough that never inflates.

tools.name: jackal_range_bound
tools.description: Emit a formal-bounded receipt with the certificate embedded (or refuse).

expression.help: Anubis expression in the single variable x, restricted to the certified fragment.

input_lo.help: Interval lower bound as an integer or reduced ℚ (e.g. '1', '2/3').

input_hi.help: Interval upper bound (canonical rational, hi >= lo).

tools.name: jackal_gaussian_integral
tools.description: Emit a zero-libm formal-bounded Gaussian integral receipt, rerun the pinned checker, or refuse without downgrade.

expression.help: Exact canonical exp(-A*(x-mu)^2) expression; all other expressions refuse.

input_lo.help: Integration lower bound as a canonical rational.

input_hi.help: Integration upper bound as a canonical rational.

tolerance.help: Maximum enclosure width as a positive canonical rational.

tools.name: jackal_verify_receipt
tools.description: Re-run the matching pinned Lean-proved range or Gaussian checker over an embedded certificate.

expected_release_epoch.help: Caller-authorized release epoch, not copied from the receipt.

expected_expression.help: Exact raw expression supplied by the caller.

expected_input_lo.help: Exact raw lower-bound token supplied by the caller.

expected_input_hi.help: Exact raw upper-bound token supplied by the caller.

expected_tolerance.help: Exact raw tolerance token; required for Gaussian receipts and forbidden for range receipts.

tools.name: jackal_sqrt_rat_bound
tools.description: Emit a formal-bounded pure-Q sqrt(x) enclosure via the untrusted producer + Lean-proved checker. NO libm on the proof-decision path. Admits ONLY the exact form 'sqrt(x)' on a canonical rational interval; every other expression refuses without downgrade. v1.4.0 fragment extension.

input_lo.help: Interval lower bound as an integer or reduced rational (e.g. '2', '1/4'); must be >= 0.

input_hi.help: Interval upper bound (canonical rational, hi >= lo).

returns.enclosure: [lo, hi] canonical rationals enclosing sqrt(x) over the input interval
returns.certificate_b64: base64 of the exact canonical certificate bytes the checker accepted

tools.name: jackal_exp_rat_bound
tools.description: Emit a formal-bounded pure-Q exp(x) enclosure via the untrusted producer + Lean-proved checker. NO libm on the proof-decision path. Admits ONLY the exact form 'exp(x)' on a canonical rational interval [lo, hi] with lo >= 0 (positive-argument branch); every other expression refuses without downgrade. v1.4.1 fragment extension.

input_lo.help: Interval lower bound as an integer or reduced rational; must be >= 0.

input_hi.help: Interval upper bound (canonical rational, hi >= lo); the producer picks a Taylor degree with 2*hi <= n+1.

returns.enclosure: [lo, hi] canonical rationals enclosing exp(x) over the input interval
returns.certificate_b64: base64 of the exact canonical certificate bytes the checker accepted

tools.name: jackal_exact
tools.description: Exact big-rational arithmetic (status=exact), independently replayed with stdlib Fraction. NOT formal: computationally exact, outside the Lean certificate chain.

expression.help: Integers, decimals, + - * / ^ (integer exponents), parentheses. Everything else refuses.

returns.fields: parsed engine key=value map (exact=, approx=, parsed=)

tools.name: jackal_evaluate
tools.description: IEEE f64 expression evaluation (status=estimated). A plain number, honestly labeled: no bound, no proof.

expression.help: Full expression grammar incl. transcendental functions and constants.

tools.name: jackal_diff
tools.description: Symbolic d/dx with numeric self-verification (status=checked). Sampled agreement is a check, not a proof of identity.

expression.help: Expression in x; non-differentiable functions fail closed.

tools.name: jackal_integrate
tools.description: Fixed-grid Simpson + Richardson error estimate (status=estimated). Grid-limited: NOT a bound.

tools.name: jackal_integrate_adaptive
tools.description: Adaptive Simpson with refusal semantics (status=estimated). Refuses when unconverged; agreement is still not a bound.

tools.name: jackal_integrate_bound
tools.description: Certified interval enclosure of an integral (status=bounded). CONDITIONAL on the stated f64/libm rounding model; implementation campaign-tested, NOT mechanized. Never labeled formal.

tools.name: jackal_solve
tools.description: Bisection root with residual + first-order conditioning diagnostics (status=estimated).
